verses.en: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.pt: Não clama porventura a sabedoria, e não faz o entendimento soar a sua voz?
verses.en_web: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?
verses.en_bbe: Is not wisdom crying out, and the voice of knowledge sounding?

verses.en: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.pt: No cume das alturas, junto ao caminho, nas encruzilhadas das veredas ela se coloca.
verses.en_web: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.
verses.en_bbe: At the top of the highways, at the meeting of the roads, she takes her place;

verses.en: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.pt: Junto às portas, à entrada da cidade, e à entrada das portas está clamando:
verses.en_web: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:
verses.en_bbe: Where the roads go into the town her cry goes out, at the doorways her voice is loud:

verses.en: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
verses.pt: A vós, ó homens, clamo; e a minha voz se dirige aos filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: “To you men, I call! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
verses.en_bbe: I am crying out to you, O men; my voice comes to the sons of men.

verses.en: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.pt: Aprendei, ó simples, a prudência; entendei, ó loucos, a sabedoria.
verses.en_web: You simple, understand prudence. You fools, be of an understanding heart.
verses.en_bbe: Become expert in reason, O you simple ones; you foolish ones, take training to heart.

verses.en: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.pt: Ouvi vós, porque profiro coisas excelentes; os meus lábios se abrem para a eqüidade.
verses.en_web: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear, for my words are true, and my lips are open to give out what is upright.

verses.en: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.pt: Porque a minha boca profere a verdade, os meus lábios abominam a impiedade.
verses.en_web: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.en_bbe: For good faith goes out of my mouth, and false lips are disgusting to me.

verses.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
verses.pt: Justas são todas as palavras da minha boca; não há nelas nenhuma coisa tortuosa nem perversa.
verses.en_web: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.
verses.en_bbe: All the words of my mouth are righteousness; there is nothing false or twisted in them.

verses.en: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.pt: Todas elas são retas para o que bem as entende, e justas para os que acham o conhecimento.
verses.en_web: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.
verses.en_bbe: They are all true to him whose mind is awake, and straightforward to those who get knowledge.

verses.en: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.pt: Aceitai antes a minha correção, e não a prata; e o conhecimento, antes do que o ouro escolhido.
verses.en_web: Receive my instruction rather than silver; knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.en_bbe: Take my teaching, and not silver; get knowledge in place of the best gold.

verses.en: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.pt: Porque melhor é a sabedoria do que as jóias; e de tudo o que se deseja nada se pode comparar com ela.
verses.en_web: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.
verses.en_bbe: For wisdom is better than jewels, and all things which may be desired are nothing in comparison with her.

verses.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
verses.pt: Eu, a sabedoria, habito com a prudência, e possuo o conhecimento e a discrição.
verses.en_web: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.
verses.en_bbe: I, wisdom, have made wise behaviour my near relation; I am seen to be the special friend of wise purposes.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.pt: O temor do Senhor é odiar o mal; a soberba, e a arrogância, e o mau caminho, e a boca perversa, eu os odeio.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord is seen in hating evil: pride, a high opinion of oneself, the evil way, and the false tongue, are unpleasing to me.

verses.en: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
verses.pt: Meu é o conselho, e a verdadeira sabedoria; eu sou o entendimento; minha é a fortaleza.
verses.en_web: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.
verses.en_bbe: Wise design and good sense are mine; reason and strength are mine.

verses.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.pt: Por mim reinam os reis, e os príncipes decretam o que justo.
verses.en_web: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.en_bbe: Through me kings have their power, and rulers give right decisions.

verses.en: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
verses.pt: Por mim governam os príncipes e os nobres, sim, todos os juízes da terra.
verses.en_web: By me princes rule; nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Through me chiefs have authority, and the noble ones are judging in righteousness.

verses.en: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.pt: Eu amo aos que me amam, e os que diligentemente me buscam me acharão.
verses.en_web: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
verses.en_bbe: Those who have given me their love are loved by me, and those who make search for me with care will get me.

verses.en: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
verses.pt: Riquezas e honra estão comigo; sim, riquezas duráveis e justiça.
verses.en_web: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.
verses.en_bbe: Wealth and honour are in my hands, even wealth without equal and righteousness.

verses.en: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.pt: Melhor é o meu fruto do que o ouro, sim, do que o ouro refinado; e a minha renda melhor do que a prata escolhida.
verses.en_web: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold; my yield than choice silver.
verses.en_bbe: My fruit is better than gold, even than the best gold; and my increase is more to be desired than silver.

verses.en: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
verses.pt: Ando pelo caminho da retidão, no meio das veredas da justiça,
verses.en_web: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice;
verses.en_bbe: I go in the road of righteousness, in the way of right judging:

verses.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.pt: dotando de bens permanentes os que me amam, e enchendo os seus tesouros.
verses.en_web: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.
verses.en_bbe: So that I may give my lovers wealth for their heritage, making their store-houses full.

verses.en: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.pt: O Senhor me criou como a primeira das suas obras, o princípio dos seus feitos mais antigos.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord made me as the start of his way, the first of his works in the past.

verses.en: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.pt: Desde a eternidade fui constituída, desde o princípio, antes de existir a terra.
verses.en_web: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.
verses.en_bbe: From eternal days I was given my place, from the birth of time, before the earth was.

verses.en: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.pt: Antes de haver abismos, fui gerada, e antes ainda de haver fontes cheias d'água.
verses.en_web: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.
verses.en_bbe: When there was no deep I was given birth, when there were no fountains flowing with water.

verses.en: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.pt: Antes que os montes fossem firmados, antes dos outeiros eu nasci,
verses.en_web: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;
verses.en_bbe: Before the mountains were put in their places, before the hills was my birth:

verses.en: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
verses.pt: quando ele ainda não tinha feito a terra com seus campos, nem sequer o princípio do pó do mundo.
verses.en_web: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.
verses.en_bbe: When he had not made the earth or the fields or the dust of the world.

verses.en: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
verses.pt: Quando ele preparava os céus, aí estava eu; quando traçava um círculo sobre a face do abismo,
verses.en_web: When he established the heavens, I was there; when he set a circle on the surface of the deep,
verses.en_bbe: When he made ready the heavens I was there: when he put an arch over the face of the deep:

verses.en: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.pt: quando estabelecia o firmamento em cima, quando se firmavam as fontes do abismo,
verses.en_web: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,
verses.en_bbe: When he made strong the skies overhead: when the fountains of the deep were fixed:

verses.en: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.pt: quando ele fixava ao mar o seu termo, para que as águas não traspassassem o seu mando, quando traçava os fundamentos da terra,
verses.en_web: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth;
verses.en_bbe: When he put a limit to the sea, so that the waters might not go against his word: when he put in position the bases of the earth:

verses.en: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.pt: então eu estava ao seu lado como arquiteto; e era cada dia as suas delícias, alegrando-me perante ele em todo o tempo;
verses.en_web: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,
verses.en_bbe: Then I was by his side, as a master workman: and I was his delight from day to day, playing before him at all times;

verses.en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
verses.pt: folgando no seu mundo habitável, e achando as minhas delícias com os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.
verses.en_bbe: Playing in his earth; and my delight was with the sons of men.

verses.en: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, filhos, ouvi-me; porque felizes são os que guardam os meus caminhos.
verses.en_web: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to me then, my sons: for happy are those who keep my ways.

verses.en: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.pt: Ouvi a correção, e sede sábios; e não a rejeiteis.
verses.en_web: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.
verses.en_bbe: Take my teaching and be wise; do not let it go.

verses.en: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.pt: Feliz é o homem que me dá ouvidos, velando cada dia às minhas entradas, esperando junto às ombreiras da minha porta.
verses.en_web: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.
verses.en_bbe: Happy is the man who gives ear to me, watching at my doors day by day, keeping his place by the pillars of my house.

verses.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
verses.pt: Porque o que me achar achará a vida, e alcançará o favor do Senhor.
verses.en_web: For whoever finds me, finds life, and will obtain favor from Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For whoever gets me gets life, and grace from the Lord will come to him.

verses.en: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.pt: Mas o que pecar contra mim fará mal à sua própria alma; todos os que me odeiam amam a morte.
verses.en_web: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”
verses.en_bbe: But he who does evil to me, does wrong to his soul: all my haters are in love with death.
